environment: Repository-native Stage 10 Cycle Review exact G-P10 review-package materialization
constraints: Task scope is limited to local exact G-P10 review-package preparation.
The current assessment must remain ready_for_human_review with can_pass_gate=false.
G-P10 must remain pending after package preparation.
The review package must bind an exact version and SHA-256 digest.
The digest basis must exclude only the digest field.
The digest basis must be compact JSON encoded as exact UTF-8 without BOM bytes.
No human G-P10 decision may be recorded by task.skillcertify.10.013.
No Git staging, commit, push, pull request or merge is authorized.
No publication or public-safe classification is authorized.
No ClinicFlow POC or new cycle is authorized.
No Strategy or WIP mutation is authorized.

alternatives.rationale: No external tool is required to serialize deterministic JSON, calculate SHA-256, verify local evidence refs, or enforce the explicit governance boundary.

selection_rationale: Task 10.014 is a bounded decision-recording and feedback.strategy handoff task; AI/tool use is limited to evidence preparation, factual consistency checks, contract interpretation, and deterministic documentation support.
The human decision source is the sole authority for the G-P10 PASS decision; the selected AI/tool has no gate-decision authority.

The execution boundary prohibits automatic Strategy/WIP changes, automatic next-cycle execution, ClinicFlow/POC startup, new-product startup, automatic publication, or unapproved Git/external actions.
risks: Incorrect property order or encoding could produce a digest inconsistent with the exact digest basis.
Including the digest field inside its own digest basis would create an invalid circular binding.
A package must not be interpreted as a G-P10 human decision.
human_controls: Explicit human authorization was required before creating stage10-evidence/10-013.
Human G-P10 decision remains reserved to task.skillcertify.10.014.
Any Git persistence or remote action requires separate explicit authorization.
review_due: on material environment/tool change or before future reuse
curation_source: CP10-013-A through CP10-013-F canonical read-only harvest
